messages:
maria: heads-up — planning a tiny latency nudge for east-asia-edge tonight at 22:00 UTC. target: shift 5% of api.lookup traffic from na-edge -> east-asia-edge for 30m window. low-risk, but want pairing and smoke run owners.
ashwin: i can pair on deploy and watch traces. what TTL are we using for the route?
leo: set TTL=60s for the change window, then restore to 300s after hold. smaller TTL to let us roll back fast if needed.
maria: correct, TTL 60. smoke checklist: 1) quick curl health 2) p95 latency and error rate dashboard check 3) request path tail sampling on traces 4) auth token churn check. assign owners?
sylvia: i'll own smoke #1 and #2 (health + p95). i'll post snapshots to #eng-platform once done.
raf: i'll do request sampling and look for any increased tail latency. also ready to flip rollback if errors spike.
ashwin: i'll be on-call for rollout steps and coordinate DNS update with infra. can someone pre-approve the tiny route weight change in the console?
maria: approved. @deploy-bot can you run a dry-run policy swap now and confirm compatibility?
deploy-bot: dry-run OK — policy package v2026.03.17-eanudge passes policy checks. compatible backends: na-edge, east-asia-edge.
leo: quick prereq: make sure the KV cache warmup policy for east-asia is enabled (warmup=prefix, duration=90s). otherwise first requests might be noisy.
sylvia: noted. i'll enable warmup 10m before.
raf: rollback plan: if error rate >0.5% absolute or p95 degrades >120ms vs baseline, revert to previous weights and TTL->300. are we good with those thresholds?
ashwin: sounds good. i'll run a synthetic load at 21:45 UTC to capture baseline and confirm alert hooks. use this curl for health smoke: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/lookup?test_ping=1`
maria: perfect. owners: deploy=ashwin, smoke=sylvia, trace/roll=raf, console toggle=leo. we start 21:50 UTC prechecks, 22:00 UTC nudge, hold @ 22:30 for review, finish 22:35 restore TTL and commit.
sylvia: i'll post screenshots of p95 and errors immediately after 22:05 and 22:20 checkpoints. :thumbsup:
leo: will be standing by to flip warmup or TTL if needed.
raf: if we need to revert, i will execute rollback runbook: `# rollback snippet
redwood route update --policy east-asia-nudge --weights na-edge=100,east-asia-edge=0 --ttl 300`
maria: nice. last question — any downstream caches we need to invalidate?
leo: only internal CDN short-lived entries during the window; i can purge a specific prefix if we see origin 5xx.
ashwin: ok logging: tag these traces with `deployment:east-asia-nudge-2026-03-17` so we can query easily.
maria: thanks all. i'll drop a final reminder 30m prior. post-mortem not expected for a small nudge unless rollback triggers.
sylvia: acknowledged — will post snapshots. good luck :party_parrot:
deploy-bot: scheduled policy swap at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z (id: swap-2478912345). reminder 30m before.
